result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: professional and workmanlike services, 12-month software conformance, 90-day service conformance, applicable-law compliance, no malicious code, and re-performance, repair, replacement, or refund remedies. The addition is targeted and does not disturb unrelated terms. Drafting is generally professional, though the software warranty running from the Effective Date rather than delivery or acceptance could shorten meaningful coverage, and “following performance” is an imprecise commencement point for the services warranty.
